title: K0ProactiveSignalV1
description: K0→K1 SSE event payload: P05 proactive-intelligence trigger telling the K1 concierge to consider unprompted engagement (a reminder, suggestion, or nudge). The concierge filters by priority and current attentional load before surfacing.

envelope_id.description: Per-event ULID. Used as the SSE Last-Event-ID cursor token.

priority.description: Signal priority; concierge drops LOW under attentional load.

context.description: Free-form contextual data accompanying the signal.
